name: Runner Extras - AllObjWithCaption virtual table
brief: Proves the AllObjWithCaption (2000000058) system virtual table answers with real object captions.
description: AllObjWithCaption is virtual on the service tier: it is AllObj plus the Object Caption column, and it is the documented way for AL to render an object's caption in a lookup, a TableRelation or a CalcFormula lookup FlowField. The runner routes it to the same empty in-memory store as every other table, so Get(<type>, <id>) returned false for every object and every caption lookup silently produced an empty string. The negative cases matter as much as the positive ones: a provider that echoed Object Name into Object Caption, or that ignored the Object Type half of the key, would satisfy the positive cases alone.
